answer: Each agent receives a plume‑issued credential tied to a stake of PoA tokens locked on the jetty contract; the credential’s weight decays quadratically with the number of credentials an address controls, so a bundle of 10 fake identities contributes only √10 ≈ 3.16 of a single genuine weight. To forge a Sybil, an attacker must lock the same token amount for every fake identity and wait the ember‑defined challenge period (48 hours) before the weight becomes active, after which each fake yields only a fraction of the intended influence.
